title: ACCOUNTS EXECUTIVE
description:
**About the Role:** We're looking for a detail\-oriented Accounts Executive to support day\-to\-day accounting operations, maintain financial records, assist with statutory compliance, and contribute to financial reporting.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Record and post purchase, sales, and journal transactions accurately, verifying invoices against POs, agreements, and approvals.
* Maintain organized financial records and expense documentation to support audits and reconciliations.
* Perform periodic bank reconciliations, identify discrepancies, and prepare reconciliation reports with necessary adjusting entries.
* Support month\-end/year\-end closing and prepare schedules and supporting documents for audits.
* Assist in VAT computation (input/output VAT), verify tax\-related invoices, and support timely VAT return filing.
* Prepare periodic MIS reports, dashboards, and summaries, highlighting trends and variances for management decision\-making.

**Requirements:**  
Bachelor's degree in Commerce/Accounting/Finance (B.Com, M.Com, MBA Finance)  
1–3 years of experience in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance operations.  
Hands\-on experience with ERP/accounting software (Odoo, Tally, Zoho Books, QuickBooks, etc.).

Working knowledge of bank reconciliation, VAT regulations, and statutory compliance.  
Proficiency in MS Excel (formulas, Pivot Tables, reporting).  
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail.  
Good communication skills and ability to maintain confidentiality of financial data.

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* How many years of hands\-on experience do you have in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance operations?

***Who We Are***

At SOTI, we are committed to delivering best\-in\-class mobile and IoT device management solutions. We are looking for out\-of\-the\-box thinkers that appreciate the art of creating great software. To us, being visionary is more important than doing things the way they have always been done.

***What We’re Looking For***

The Customer Bug (Jira) Analysis Team is a team within SOTI's Executive Escalations team that consists of team members with intensive EMM (SOTI MobiControl) product knowledge, proven customer\-facing, troubleshooting and escalations experience. Also skilled with deep\-level analysis of JIRA tickets. The team’s main function is to thoroughly analyze, debug, and provide fixes or workarounds to incoming JIRA tickets before reaching the core development team. The contribution of this team will in turn result in high\-quality bug tickets that truly need code fixes and will also alleviate workloads from developers. Software Analyst is responsible for reviewing and troubleshooting JIRA tickets coming from various departments such as the Technical Support team, Professional Services, Pre\-Sales, etc. The role involves critical issue analysis and research, testing, and advanced\-level troubleshooting techniques. Code referral and fix suggestions are also needed to identify potential bugs and solutions, respectively.

***What’s in it for you?***

*The People* \- From our humble origins in our founder’s basement, to our industry\-leading position today, SOTI has worked hard to foster a company culture that we can all believe in. A culture that emphasizes personal growth, continuous innovation, and fun.

*The Growth* \- Our environment fosters new ideas, fresh perspectives, and the ability to take them over the goal line. SOTI is a fast\-paced environment with a global reach that encourages you to make your mark and be part of something big!

*The Technology* \- You’ll get the chance to work with leading\-edge technologies and take on complex and interesting projects, as part of highly collaborative and agile teams. You will work alongside SOTI’s partners which include leading tech giants that will keep you on the cusp of emerging technologies.

***What You’ll Do***

* Analyzing debug log files and crash analysis, bug identification, suggesting fixes and coordinating with the engineering team to implement the bug fixes in future releases for MobiControl products
* Identifying MobiControl server\-side and client\-side limitations based on information gathered from the customer’s production environment
* Working with internal teams to develop, maintain, and update diagnostic tools internally to check configuration\-related issues and log files for multiple mobile platforms
* Troubleshooting, researching, and coordinating with frontline teams to evaluate the issue and narrow down the process/procedure or method that is causing the failure
* Identifying issues that are caused by the latest operating system or product updates, and coordinating with the engineering team to provide patches for fixing the issues

***Experience You’ll Bring:***

* Degree in Computer Information/Application Systems, Enterprise Computing, Information Technology, or equivalent experience
* Experience: Good to have experience in MDM or software development or related field (Exceptions apply)
* Well\-versed with enterprise MDM solutions and applications
* Knowledge and experience with various mobile platforms such as Android, Android Enterprise, and iOS
* Knowledgeable in Java/Android/Kotlin, C\#, .NET, and development platforms such as Android Studio, and Visual Studio
* Familiar with Git, software development, and the JIRA platform
* Familiar with Agile and project management
* Knowledgeable in SQL, Windows, and server management and administration
* Knowledgeable in networking concepts and various IT architectures and infrastructures
* Excellent critical thinking and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience with building custom applications for various use/business cases

title: Executive Secretary to Director
description:
**Executive Secretary to Director** 

**Position:** Executive Secretary to Director  
**Department:** Administration / Executive Office  
**Reports To:** Director / Managing Director  
**Industry:** FMCG

**Job Summary**

The Executive Secretary to the Director provides high\-level administrative, secretarial, accounting, and coordination support to the Director. The role involves managing schedules, correspondence, basic financial records, meetings, travel arrangements, documentation, and coordination with internal departments, suppliers, customers, and government authorities to ensure smooth business operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Executive \& Administrative Support**

* Manage the Director's calendar, appointments, meetings, and travel schedules.
* Screen phone calls, emails, and visitors on behalf of the Director.
* Draft and prepare letters, reports, presentations, and official correspondence.
* Maintain confidential records, documents, and files.
* Organize and coordinate board meetings, management reviews, and business discussions.

**Finance \& Accounting Support**

* Handle basic bookkeeping, expense tracking, and petty cash management for the executive office.
* Assist with invoice processing, vendor payment follow\-ups, and reconciliation of executive accounts.
* Prepare basic financial summaries, expense reports, and budget tracking documents.
* Coordinate with the internal finance team for timely submission of bills, vouchers, and reimbursement claims.

**Meeting Coordination**

* Prepare meeting agendas and presentation materials.
* Attend meetings and record Minutes of Meeting (MoM).
* Track action items and follow up with department heads for timely completion.
* Coordinate communication between the Director and various departments.

**Business Coordination**

* Liaise with procurement, production, quality, sales, logistics, and finance teams.
* Coordinate with rice suppliers, traders, exporters, transporters, and government agencies.
* Assist in preparing business reports, production summaries, and management dashboards.
* Monitor key deadlines, compliance submissions, and project activities.

**Documentation \& Communication**

* Prepare presentations, MIS reports, and business correspondence.
* Maintain records of contracts, licenses, certifications, statutory documents, and financial files.
* Ensure proper filing and retrieval of important company records.
* Handle confidential business and financial information with strict discretion.

**Required Qualifications**

* **B.Com / M.Com or equivalent degree.**
* Minimum **2 years of experience in accounting, bookkeeping, or financial administration** required.

**Skills Required**

* Solid understanding of core accounting principles, financial management, and bookkeeping.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time\-management abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) and accounting software (e.g., Tally, QuickBooks, ERP modules).
* High level of confidentiality, accuracy with financial data, and professionalism.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
